thread:
Leah Park: Uploading Emerald Systems final art to Drive: https://drive.company/emerald/final. Quick QA before we publish the joint solution brief — badge placement, alt text, and partner quote attribution. Need sign-off by EOD Fri PT. Any immediate red flags?

Marco Rivera: On it. Link works. The emerald logo PNGs in /final/logos look good but there's a 3px white stroke on the mono version — can we get an SVG without the stroke? Also Emerald asked for a 1:1 lockup variant for the marketplace listing, not just horizontal.

Priya Shah: Thanks — pinging Design. For alt text, do we want the simple brand-only text or include product context? Draft alt: "Emerald Systems logo — joint Redwood Inference + Emerald Systems solution brief". Thoughts?

DesignBot: Design checklist: clearspace = 8px; min thumb width = 72px; provide SVG; emerald primary hex #00695C. Suggested lockup file: emerald_redwood_lockup.svg. Uploaded hero mock (cropped right) at drive.link/emerald/hero_mock.png.

Tom Ellis (Legal): Legal note: Emerald provided a trademark usage doc — they require ™ on first mention of "Emerald Systems" and their claim line must be verbatim. Also they forbid use of partner customer names without express written approval — any customer quotes must be masked or use descriptors (e.g., "major fintech"). Please attach legal_text.txt to the asset package.

Marco Rivera: @Tom noted. Leah — do we already have Emerald's approval on the quote redaction?

Leah Park: Yes, Emerald approved the quote with the customer masked; they asked we use "major fintech" in the case study. Title stays "Reducing inference cost by 3x" per their ask.

Priya Shah: For marketplace thumbnail: target 1200x675, logo top-left, lockup bottom-right. Short alt text for thumbnail: "Redwood + Emerald solution brief cover". We'll add the longer accessibility alt on the download page.

DesignBot: Accessibility flag: contrast check fails for white 16px text over emerald gradient; recommend bump to 18px bold or add 28% black overlay. Will prep two variants. Also note: use SVG lockup for marketplace to avoid aliasing.

Leah Park: Action items: Design to deliver SVG lockup + marketplace thumbnail; Legal to append trademark string to assets; Partnerships to collect final sign-off from Emerald by Thu COB. Marco/Priya — can you coordinate and confirm? I'll set a 3pm PT sync tomorrow. :calendar: 

Marco Rivera: Scheduling invite now. I also asked Emerald for a high-res, customer-approved quote image in case they can share — if they do we'll swap the masked version.

Priya Shah: Added checklist to Drive and noted alt text variants and accessibility items. TL;DR: need Emerald sign-off by Thu 5pm PT for publish.

DesignBot: Uploaded emerald_redwood_lockup_v2.svg to Drive (drive.link/emerald/lockups). Added alt text examples: short = "Redwood + Emerald solution brief cover"; long = "Cover showing Redwood Inference and Emerald Systems partnership, logos side-by-side, with headline 'Reducing inference cost by 3x'". Also attached a contrast-fixed hero variant: drive.link/emerald/hero_fix.png.

Leah Park: Perfect — thanks everyone. Will follow up after 3pm sync. :thumbsup:
